findings.location: <div class="poem"> — stanza beginning "But O these wonders of Thy grace" (third stanza), third line
findings.source_quote: These marvels sweeter far to trace,
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the comparative and sense of "sweeter far to trace" (meaning: far sweeter to follow/trace/observe) rather than rendering as "à suivre avec audace". Suggested French replacement (preserving tags and line breaks): "Ces prodiges, bien plus doux à contempler,"
findings.translation_quote: Ces prodiges à suivre avec audace,

findings.location: <div class="poem"> — stanza beginning "Divine Redeemer, Thee I bless" (second stanza), third line
findings.source_quote: I love Thee in the loveliness
findings.suggested_fix: "la beauté ravie" is awkward and risks changing nuance. Prefer a clearer, idiomatic rendering that preserves sense, for example: "Je T'aime dans la beauté ravissante" or simply "Je T'aime dans la beauté". Keep original HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Je T'aime dans la beauté ravie
